_doc: Garden items (ADR-0049): seeds and what plants them, the produce of game/data/crops, what is cooked from it, and the bucket that carries water to a bed. Models are made by tools/assetgen/blender/generators/farm_garden.py (catalog blender_catalogs/farming.py), hence the explicit items/garden/<id> model ids.

defs.name: Seed Potatoes
defs.description: A paper sack of small potatoes gone to sprout. Bury them in a garden bed and keep them wet.

defs.name: Carrot Seeds
defs.description: A seed packet, DANVERS HALF-LONG. Plant it in a garden bed.

defs.name: Pole Bean Seeds
defs.description: A seed packet, KENTUCKY WONDER. They climb whatever you give them.

defs.name: Huckleberry Seeds
defs.description: Tiny seeds picked out of crushed berries and dried on a scrap of cloth. Slow, but a bush keeps giving.

defs.name: Yarrow Seeds
defs.description: Shaken from a dry yarrow head. A bed of it keeps you in poultices.

defs.name: Potato
defs.description: Fresh out of the ground. Edible raw, better baked. Bury one and it grows again.

defs.name: Carrot
defs.description: Crisp, with dirt on it. Sweeter than anything in a can.

defs.name: Green Beans
defs.description: A handful of pods snapped off the vine.

defs.name: Baked Potato
defs.description: Buried in the coals until the skin cracked.

defs.name: Garden Stew
defs.description: Potato, carrot and beans boiled down in a can. The first meal in weeks that tastes of something.

defs.name: Bucket
defs.description: A galvanised pail. Fill it at a stream or a rain catcher; one bucket soaks a whole garden bed.

defs.name: Bucket of Water
defs.description: Murky and heavy. For the garden, or a rain catcher's worth of bottles to boil.
